title: Two Tenderloin tenants were overcharged after rent notices went unprocessed

beats.text: Two tenants in a six-file San Francisco audit paid too much rent.

visual.sub: Two overcharges under the same manager

beats.text: The auditors found 2 exceptions in 6 Section 8 files.

visual.kicker: Two overcharges under the same manager

beats.text: At Cameo the tenant initially paid $259 a month.

visual.label: A notice with a retroactive effective date

beats.text: The housing authority sent a December notice that took effect back in June.

visual.kicker: A notice with a retroactive effective date

beats.text: The notice date was 189 days after its effective date.
At Yosemite the notice reduced rent from $212 to $210.
It was still unprocessed 213 days after the notice date.
The audit records retroactive credits for both tenants.

visual.kicker: Credits and the later control test

beats.text: A new manager arrived in April 2018.

visual.kicker: Credits and the later control test

beats.text: The next audit found no similar issue.

visual.kicker: Credits and the later control test

beats.text: The individual credit posting dates were not reported.

visual.kicker: Credits and the later control test
